title: fix(settings)!: a cloud-managed environment does not offer its file storage or AI provider settings
body:
domain:server#5 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTEivi2wogPpeo3xd5

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbTGhxJSYAmQXU7efVdNqrpw)_

Fixes #33891

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — in a cloud-managed process (`OS_CLOUD_MANAGED=1`) only, the settings doors stop serving `storage` and the `ai` provider/model/credential/generation-default/embedder keys: `GET /api/settings` leaves them out, `GET`/`PUT /api/settings/storage`, a `PUT /api/settings/ai` naming a hidden key, and `POST storage/*`, `ai/test`, `ai/test_embedder`, `ai/reset` answer `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` (`details.managedBy: 'platform'`), and the data-API reads of the four settings stores leave out those rows for any non-system caller. A self-hosted deployment answers exactly as before.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no skill under `skills/**` teaches the hosted settings doors or the storage / AI settings pages.

**BREAKING** for a caller of a cloud-managed environment: its file storage and AI provider are the hosting platform's, so the settings doors no longer show or change them. The registry stays whole, so the storage and AI services keep reading every value in process. The changeset carries the ADR-0087 not-required marker (no-migration-prescription).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:托管环境(`OS_CLOUD_MANAGED=1`)下,设置接口不再显示或修改文件存储设置、AI 提供商/模型/凭据/生成默认值/Embedder;会话标题与可观测性仍可配置;Setup 菜单的「文件存储」在托管下隐藏。
- 为什么改:这些由托管平台提供和配置,环境管理员看到或改动它们只会误导或弄坏平台配置(维护者裁定方案 A:服务端按托管裁剪并拒绝)。
- 风险与回滚:只影响托管进程;自托管完全不变。注册表保持完整,存储与 AI 服务在进程内照常读取。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/services/service-settings/src/cloud-managed-settings.ts`(隐藏表与裁剪规则)、`packages/services/service-settings/src/settings-routes.ts`(各入口的检查点)、`packages/services/service-settings/src/settings-read-door.ts`(数据 API 读取过滤)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-settings exec vitest run src/cloud-managed-settings.pin.test.ts src/settings-read-door.pin.test.ts`,预期全绿:托管各入口 409,自托管对照照旧。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地;控制台「此项由平台托管」提示页另由席位开 ui 卡。

## What changes

- New `packages/services/service-settings/src/cloud-managed-settings.ts`:
  - The ONE hosted table `CLOUD_MANAGED_HIDDEN_SETTINGS`. `storage` is hidden whole, with every action. `ai` hides a key list: `provider`, every per-provider model / credential / base-URL key, `temperature`, `max_tokens`, `request_timeout_ms` and the six `embedder_*` keys; its `test`, `test_embedder` and `reset` actions are refused. `CLOUD_MANAGED_SERVED_AI_KEYS` is the pinned complement: `title_generation_enabled`, `title_max_length`, `trace_enabled`, `log_prompts`.
  - Gated on `isCloudManaged()` from `@objectstack/core`, and nothing else.
  - The projection drops the hidden keys, the refused action buttons, and every group section left with no served key. The `ai` page keeps its Conversation titles and Observability sections.
  - The refusal is `SettingsCloudManagedError`, answered `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` with `details: { namespace, managedBy: 'platform', keys? | actionId? }`.
- `settings-routes.ts` asks the table at every door:
  - `GET /api/settings`: projected list;
  - `GET /api/settings/:namespace`: whole-hidden namespaces refused first; manifest, `values` and `live` projected;
  - `PUT /api/settings/:namespace`: refused whole, before anything is applied, when the body names a hidden key;
  - `POST /api/settings/:namespace/:actionId`: the refused actions.
  - The refusal is mapped once, in the family door.
- `settings-read-door.ts`: in a hosted process a non-system read of `sys_setting`, `sys_setting_audit`, `sys_platform_setting` or `sys_platform_setting_audit` ANDs in `cloudManagedRowScope()`. That scope leaves out every `storage` row and every row of a hidden `ai` key. A system context still reads all rows.
- `@objectstack/platform-objects`: `nav_settings_storage` carries `visible: 'features.cloudManaged != true'`. `features` is a root every nav entry binds. The AI entry stays, because part of its page is still served.

## Tests

- New `service-settings/src/cloud-managed-settings.pin.test.ts` drives every route twice on one composition: hosted, and self-hosted as the control.
  - The table classifies every `ai` key as hidden or served, never both or neither. A new `ai` key fails here until it is classified.
  - GET list, GET `storage`, GET `ai` (keys, values, groups, buttons), PUT `storage`, and a PUT `ai` naming `temperature` beside `title_max_length`: the call is refused and nothing is written. The served-only PUT is written. POST `storage/test`, `ai/test`, `ai/test_embedder` and `ai/reset` are covered too.
  - The in-process reader still reads `storage` and `ai.provider`.
  - The storage nav entry's `visible`, and that the AI entry has none.
- `settings-read-door.pin.test.ts` gains a hosted and self-hosted describe on the real engine. Over `sys_setting` and `sys_platform_setting`, a reader holding every capability reads only `ai.trace_enabled` when hosted and all four rows self-hosted; a count agrees with the list; the system reads all four.

## Acceptance notes

- E1: this is a new door check, not branding's registry withholding. The registry stays whole, so `storage-service-plugin.ts`'s in-process `getNamespace('storage')` and the AI service's reads keep working; this is pinned.
- E2: the refusal code is the house cloud-managed answer, `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, with no code minted (as in plugin-auth `cloudManagedRefusal`). It is told apart from `404 UNKNOWN_NAMESPACE` by code, and `details.managedBy: 'platform'` names the reason. No error-code ledger change.
- `ai/reset` is refused besides the three named actions, because it clears every stored `ai` row, hidden ones included.
- The 「此项由平台托管」 console page is not in this PR (`ui/**` is closed to the server seat). It is reported for a ui follow-up card.
- A `live` statement on the `ai` page is filtered by key. A banner text is served as its provider writes it; no provider in this repository registers one for `ai`.
- Base: this PR is cut from `origin/main` and is independent of the knowledge-settings PR for #33933. Whichever lands second re-reads the other's `ai` manifest change. The hidden key list names the `embedder_*` keys whichever way that lands.

## Verification

All verify runs go through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` and quote the lock's `VERDICT command-exit 0` line. Final head is `6fc6664eed`: `4018e852c2` plus a merge of `origin/main`.

<details><summary>Package tests and typecheck</summary>

- At `4018e852c2`:
  - `@objectstack/service-settings` test: Test Files 76 passed (76), Tests 1501 passed (1501); typecheck exit 0.
  - `@objectstack/platform-objects` test: Test Files 122 passed (122), Tests 2007 passed (2007).
- At the final head `6fc6664eed`: `cloud-managed-settings.pin.test.ts`, `settings-read-door.pin.test.ts` and `settings-translation-coverage.test.ts` (which the merge changed): Test Files 3 passed (3), Tests 220 passed (220).
</details>

<details><summary>Dogfood battery (narrowing) at 6fc6664eed</summary>

- `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/dogfood^...' build`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the lock, with no shard and no path: Test Files 4 failed, 465 passed, 3 skipped (472); Tests 8 failed, 3966 passed, 42 skipped (4016).
- The four failing files are `bare-name-one-holder-flow-family`, `package-commit-revert-path-package`, `permission-set-clone-door` and `wall-package-refusal`.
  - None of them sets `OS_CLOUD_MANAGED` or reads `/api/settings`.
  - Re-run alone on the same head and the same build, they pass: Test Files 4 passed (4), Tests 58 passed (58).
  - Two of them also failed in an unrelated run on another branch the same night.
  - Read as box contention, not as this change; CI's battery is the deciding run.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation of every pin (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, WRAP restore, blob == HEAD and git diff HEAD empty after each leg)</summary>

Tests are src-aliased, so no dist leg is needed.

- B1, the GET-namespace check removed: red. `GET storage` hosted.
- B2, the write check removed: red. `PUT storage`, and the whole-call refusal of `temperature` plus `title_max_length`.
- B3, the action check removed: red. `storage/test`, `ai/test`, `ai/test_embedder`, `ai/reset`.
- B4, the list projection removed: red. `GET /api/settings`.
- B5, the manifest projection removed: red. `GET ai`.
- B6, the values projection removed: red. `GET ai`.
- B7, the refusal mapping disabled: red, 7 cases (every refusal falls to the route's own arm).
- B8, the read-door hosted scope disabled: red, 4 cases (list and count over `sys_setting` and `sys_platform_setting`).
- B9, the nav `visible` removed:
  - The first attempt was a no-op: the tool refused it because the replacement already occurred in the file.
  - B9b: red, the storage entry pin.
- The `live` projection has no ablation leg: no provider in this repository registers an `ai` live statement.
</details>

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

- `dispatch-gates --commands` at `6fc6664eed`: 72 families. `--ran`: 72 derived, 70 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED (derived from a recorded exit 3).
  - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` needs a full `pnpm build` of every package.
  - `check:type-check-debt`'s closure build timed out in the shared lock queue.
  - CI runs both.
- `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main`: OK, 9 anchors, 0 lost.
- `check-nul-bytes`: OK. eslint `--no-inline-config` on the changed files: exit 0.
- `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main HEAD`: exit 0.
</details>
